nodes.label: Jonathan L. Portfolio Website
nodes.rationale: A modern, responsive, and performant personal portfolio website built to showcase projects, skills, and professional experience. Developed with a focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and an intuitive user interface.

nodes.label: Feature-Sliced Design (FSD)
nodes.rationale: The codebase follows a scalable architecture inspired by Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) to ensure modularity and separation of concerns.

nodes.label: PNPM Workspace Configuration
nodes.rationale: Allows build scripts for specific packages in the pnpm workspace: @sentry/cli, msw, sharp, and unrs-resolver.

nodes.label: Lighthouse Performance Report
nodes.rationale: Lighthouse audit conducted on 2026-05-21 for http://localhost:3000/ using HeadlessChrome 148.0.0.0. baseline performance shows First Contentful Paint of 6.9s (score 0.01) and Largest Contentful Paint of 15.9s (score 0) on mobile emulation (Moto G Power), revealing significant performance issues on initial page load.
